title: CalculationProcedureVariable - Data API
description: Defines a variable in an Expression Set. The label for this object is Expression Set Variable. This object is available in API version 53.0 and later.

ApiName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ApiName.description: The API name of this variable.

CalculationMatrixName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
CalculationMatrixName.description: The name of the Decision Matrix to which this variable belongs. Applicable only if this variable references a Decision Matrix column.

CalculationProcedureVersionId.description: The ID of the Expression Set Version to which this variable belongs. This is a relationship field.

DataType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
DataType.description: The data type of this variable. Possible values are: Boolean Currency Date Number Percent Text

DefaultValue.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DefaultValue.description: The default value of this variable.

DisplayName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DisplayName.description: The user-readable name of this variable.

IsEditable.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsEditable.description: If true, specifies that a variable is NOT auto-imported from a step that calls a Decision Matrix or a child Expression Set. The default value is false.

IsUserDefined.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsUserDefined.description: Specifies whether a variable is defined by the user. The default value is false.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update

Precision.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Precision.description: The number of decimal places. Applicable if the DataType is Currency, Number, or Percent.

UiDisplayOrder.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
UiDisplayOrder.description: The display order of the variable in the UI.

special_access_rules: Access to Expression Sets requires OmniStudio licenses.
